/seo/pageTitle.source_en: Busan Cruise Shore Excursion: Coastal Bus Tour | AtoC Korea

/seo/description.source_en: Large-coach Busan coastal day tour for cruise passengers: 8 signature stops with cruise-terminal pickup and a return-before-sail-away guarantee.

/seo/metaDescription.source_en: 9-hour Busan coastal bus tour for cruise passengers from Busan Port Cruise Terminal: Yonggungsa, UN Memorial, Jagalchi/BIFF/Gukje, Gamcheon, Songdo, Yongdusan — return guaranteed before sail-away.

/hero/meta/duration.source_en: ≈ 9 hours, timed to your cruise's port-call window

/hero/tagline.source_en: Eight Busan signatures on a large coach — picked up at your cruise terminal and returned with comfortable buffer before sail-away

/catalog_card/title.source_en: Busan Cruise Shore: Coastal Bus Tour

/catalog_card/imageAlt.source_en: AtoC Korea white tour coach waiting at Busan International Cruise Terminal with a moored cruise liner and a guide welcoming a four-guest party arriving from the ship

/catalog_card/subtitle.source_en: 8-stop Busan coastal circuit on a large coach, with cruise-terminal pickup and return planned around your ship's sail-away.

/catalog_card/shortCardDescription.source_en: A large-coach Busan coastal day tour built for cruise passengers: cruise terminal pickup, 8 signature stops (⟦G2⟧, ⟦G1⟧, ⟦G3⟧, ⟦G7⟧, ⟦G5⟧, ⟦G0⟧, ⟦G6⟧, ⟦G4⟧), and a return-before-sail-away guarantee. Budget tier — same circuit as the small-group product, larger coach.

/pickup_dropoff/primary/name.source_en: Busan International Cruise Terminal (영도 크루즈항 — Dongsam, Yeongdo)

/pickup_dropoff/primary/time.source_en: Confirmed at booking (≈30 min after ship docking) / Return ≈90 min before sail-away

/pickup_dropoff/primary/instructions.source_en: For large cruise ships. Meet the guide at the terminal arrival hall — look for the 'AtoC Korea' sign. Coach parked in the terminal coach lot.

/pickup_dropoff/alternates/0/name.source_en: Busan Port International Passenger Terminal (부산항국제여객터미널 — Choryang)

/pickup_dropoff/alternates/0/time.source_en: Alternate pickup for ships docking at Choryang

/pickup_dropoff/alternates/0/instruction.source_en: If your cruise line docks at the Choryang International Passenger Terminal rather than the Yeongdo Cruise Terminal, notify at booking — the coach will pick up at the Choryang terminal arrival hall instead.
